text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since the tryouts, but
I'm still hung up on what
happened.
Which, uh, potentially explains why I've
wandered my way
to the riverbank without
realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki was like a different person
in the race, compared to
how she was
when I saw her here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...The trainer who came to watch me at the
tryouts. I apologize for not
greeting you
then, but I did notice you in the stands,
and I'm most
grateful that you attended.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I only wish... that I had not put on such a
disappointing display after
inviting you. I
am deeply shamed by it...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...You are quite perceptive.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I had to say which was more
representative of my natural state, it

would be the side of me you saw at the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Recklessly charging at things, unable to
contain the blaze in my
heart... I was not
born experienced, after all.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Argh, just shut up! I just... I'm so mad! I hate this! I hate how my vision goes all hot and red!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In my youth, I was no better than an
animal, violently acting upon my
every
emotion and whim. I thought dominance...
power was the
solution to any
inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
For I knew not any other way to achieve
my will. I let the heat in me
boil over,
hurting others—and they shunned me for
it.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fine, then! I'll just take 'em down! I'll get rid of all those dumb weaklings, and... have fun by myself... alone...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Weaklings," hm? I see. In that case, you'll
never be alone—not with
someone as
strong as Grampa around.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah... G-Grampa.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's already past time for your
training, Yaeno. Let's get to
the dojo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
He was the one person who stayed by my
side, through all my
naivety—my
grandfather, head of the Kongo Yaegaki
school of
unarmed martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And he told me something about the blaze
inside me... If I whipped
that raw flame
around like a weapon, it would burn me
along with
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
He taught me that Kongo Yaegaki forms
can temper my once aimless
rampages...
And that controlling my strength will show
me how water
balances so perfectly even
and still.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Through daily training under his
mastery, I learned techniques to
restrain
my aggressive instincts. And eventually, I
learned to get
along with others.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But though I tried to maintain water's
tranquility, the fire was still
smouldering
within...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was so terrified that it would flare back
up and hurt the people
around me. Until
one day, Grampa asked me something.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
There is a way to best others without
harming them—to compete out
of joy, not
hate. It is a discipline where a raging blaze
can become a
beacon of light. Now, what
do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I may, I'd like to pose you the same
question. What do you think my

grandfather meant?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A way to enjoy competition without
harming others... I'm fairly sure I
know the
answer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You have a sharp mind indeed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I learned of racing, I was overjoyed,
for I finally knew the path I
was meant to
take.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Martial arts would give me control over
the violent blaze, and races
would give me
a place to wield it, a place where it would
shine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And then... I had a thought. If I performed
well in races—if I achieved
glory... then I
could finally pay him back.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Grampa... I've caused him so much grief
and worry. I wanted to show
him something
to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And yet—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even here! Even in races, the aggression
overtakes me, bringing
nothing but bitter
humiliation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have to beat this naivety back! I have to
beat the blaze that stokes
my temper!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Or else, I'll... I'll never be more than an
amateur. I'll never repay the
debt I owe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I need to train more. I must train harder...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lack of control pains her so, and yet
Yaeno Muteki works
diligently to
overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her resolve, I reflexively speak up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Why would you do that? From a trainer's
perspective, I'm just an
aggressive, unruly
Umamusume. There's no merit to training
someone
like me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely sincere—looking her
straight in the eyes as I continue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...You truly mean it. Your words, your
eyes... they speak to your
unwavering
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I'm honest, I recognize that I'm lacking
guidance in this field. I
humbly ask your
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wish to control the blaze inside me...
Would you help me find the
way?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I am most grateful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A massive wall looms in Yaeno Muteki's
path... But we'll think of a
way to conquer
it—together!
